title: Monsoon Chicken Stew
description: A flavorful and spicy stew made with chicken thighs and a blend of spices, perfect for a cold day.

ingredients.name: monsoon
ingredients.notes: Monsoon sauce or a combination of soy sauce, vinegar, and chili flakes

ingredients.name: stew
ingredients.notes: Chicken broth or a combination of water and bouillon powder

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chicken thighs and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the monsoon sauce, stew, quick, and american to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
